The '''Techaide''' was manufactured by [[Drever Corporation]]. It was a handheld device that helped [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to check mechanical systems. The device could assess damage to equipment, and was able to diagnose faults with the electrical systems, hydraulic pressures, energy fluctuations, and structural weakness.
